title: Bix and the Wolverines loving symphonic music
summary: The group went to hear the Cincinnati Symphony and New York Philharmonic; Bix's love of Debussy, Eastwood Lane and MacDowell.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Play timpani beautifully. Who's idea? Was it Vic's idea to go to the Cincinnati Symphony? The group you all went together?

We all did. We all loved it. And the proof of the pudding is that the first night we were together in five years in New York City, we don't go to hear a jam band. We go to hear the New York Philharmonic Symphony. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
